purpose: Challenge the sole selected Campaign152 mechanism against the complete frozen library and reject its five alternatives before opening any historical minute, candidate, comparator, price or return value.

exact_prevalue_mechanism.bar_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 from the immutable 241-row stock-day source identity; 09:30 is excluded and no lunch, overnight, cross-date or cross-stock transition is formed.
exact_prevalue_mechanism.amount_state: Require every selected raw CNY amount a_i finite and nonnegative; exact zeros remain zero.
exact_prevalue_mechanism.total: S=sum_i(a_i) over exactly 240 selected bars; require S finite and strictly positive.
exact_prevalue_mechanism.normalization: None across bars, dates, stocks, peers, capitalization, free float or terminal factors.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both read the complete 240-bar amount vector.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Entropy divides by session total and is invariant to any positive common scale; Campaign152 changes strictly with that scale and ignores the normalized allocation shape.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m, intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m and intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: All use transaction amount over the fixed clock.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Every listed clock statistic normalizes by total amount and therefore discards magnitude; Campaign152 retains magnitude and discards clock allocation.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_active_trading_bar_share_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both require the exact continuous-session grid.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Activity share is a binary support count invariant to arbitrary changes in every positive amount; Campaign152 uses all positive magnitudes and does not divide by support.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: signal_day_turnover_rate_pct
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Turnover rate divides traded shares by a provider free-float denominator. Campaign152 reads no share volume or free-float state and measures monetary capacity without a capitalization normalization.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_terminal_nominal_share_price_affordability_rank_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Nominal price can influence the amount generated by a fixed number of shares.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Affordability reads terminal price only and is invariant to traded quantity; Campaign152 reads no price and changes with transaction quantity at unchanged prices.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_relative_amount_share_clock_center_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Campaign151 divides own amount by same-clock peers, renormalizes the 240 ratios and is invariant to a common own-stock scale. Campaign152 uses no peer state or clock moment and changes strictly with that common scale.

invariance_challenges.common_own_scale: Multiplying all 240 own-stock amounts by c>0 increases Campaign152 from log1p(S) to log1p(cS), while every normalized own amount distribution and Campaign151 relative-share clock center remains unchanged.
invariance_challenges.clock_permutation: Permuting the 240 amount positions leaves Campaign152 unchanged but can change all amount-clock, peak, run, path and profile-synchronization factors.
invariance_challenges.shape_change_at_fixed_total: Redistributing amount across bars while holding S fixed leaves Campaign152 unchanged but changes timing, concentration, serial and event-spacing factors.
invariance_challenges.price_quantity_substitution: Holding monetary amount fixed while changing the price/share-volume decomposition leaves Campaign152 unchanged but can change affordability, volume and turnover states.
